title: Find the length of the longest line in a file
summary: Use the wc command to find out how many characters are in the longest line of a file. This is helpful for checking if lines are too long for a specific format.

steps.explain: Run wc with the --max-line-length flag followed by the path to your file. This prints the number of characters in the longest line.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the text file you want to analyze

alternatives.explain: Use the short flag -L instead of --max-line-length.
